function.arguments: {"command": "awk 'NR==1 {printf \"%-10s %-10s %-10s %-10s %-10s %-10s\\n\", \"Region\", \"Jul\", \"Aug\", \"Sep\", \"Q3 Total\", \"QoQ Growth\"} NR>1 && NR<=4 {region=$1; jul=0; aug=0; sep=0; total=0; getline < \"data/q3/\" region \"_2024-07.csv\"; jul=$5; getline < \"data/q3/\" region \"_2024-08.csv\"; aug=$5; getline < \"data/q3/\" region \"_2024-09.csv\"; sep=$5; total=jul+aug+sep; q2_total=0; getline < \"data/q2_summary.csv\"; if ($1==region) q2_total=$2; growth=(total-q2_total)/q2_total*100; printf \"%-10s %-10.2f %-10.2f %-10.2f %-10.2f %-10.2f%%\\n\", region, jul, aug, sep, total, growth} NR>4 {q2_total+=$1} END {printf \"%-10s %-10s %-10s %-10s %-10s %-10s\\n\", \"Q2 Total\", \"\", \"\", \"\", q2_total, \"\"}' data/q3/amer_2024-07.csv > reports/q3_table.txt"}
